This Belton Farmhouse Offers Low Taxes, City Amenities, and Endless Potential!

FREE GUIDE:
Home Buyer Guide → https://bit.ly/3AloH57 

Welcome to Living in Central Texas! I’m Aundrea Dudik, Realtor and Associate Broker with Vista Real Estate. Today, I’m excited to showcase this Belton Farmhouse, offering low taxes, proximity to city amenities, and endless potential – it could be your next dream home! 

If you love the idea of peaceful country living but still want easy access to modern conveniences, this Belton Farmhouse is for you. Located just outside the city limits, this property allows you to take advantage of low taxes while being close to all the city amenities you need. It’s a rare combination that makes this Belton Farmhouse a standout in the area.

📍 3200 Auction Barn Road, Belton, TX 76513

Property Highlights:
✨ Just 5 minutes from Stillhouse Hollow Lake, perfect for outdoor activities like fishing, camping, and hiking.
✨ Only 25 minutes from Fort Cavazos (formerly Fort Hood), 1 hour from Austin, and 45 minutes from Waco, making it easy to enjoy all the city amenities nearby.
✨ Lot Size: 0.8 acres offering plenty of space for outdoor activities and projects.
✨ The home includes a rare storm shelter, a large backyard, and a newly laid 20x40 concrete slab perfect for an outdoor kitchen or workshop.

If you’re looking for a Belton Farmhouse with low taxes and easy access to city amenities, this property has it all.
